claim: Voie des Vignes from Beaune to Santenay is 23 km, easy difficulty (149 m ascent), passing Pommard, Meursault and Chassagne-Montrachet, connecting at Santenay to the Canal du Centre greenway toward Chalon.
quote: At Santenay, you can continue cycling south for Chalon by following the greenway along the Canal du Centre's towpath.

claim: EuroVelo 6 between Chalon-sur-Saône and Santenay runs 24 km along the Canal du Centre towpath, with Chagny's canal port sitting roughly halfway between Rully and Santenay.
quote: Chagny's port comes next after the canal port at La Plaine de Rully, followed by that of Santenay.

claim: Les Cabottes in Change (between Santenay and Beaune, directly on the Voie des Vignes) rents e-bikes at €25 half-day / €45 full day, with child seats, trailers (€15/€25) and helmets included.
quote: Half-day: €25 (morning 9am-1pm or afternoon 2pm-6pm) and €45 for a full day

claim: Santenay Tourist Office rents standard and electric bikes, with e-bikes at €25 half-day / €35 full day.
quote: Electrically-assisted bikes cost €25 for a half day and €35 for a full day

claim: Bourgogne Randonnées in Beaune is the most-reviewed Burgundy bike-rental shop, offering classic, road and electric bikes for exploring the Côte de Beaune from a central Beaune location.
quote: Bike rental in Beaune in Côte d'Or (21)

claim: From Saint-Léger-sur-Dheune (about 15 km from Chagny) CrisBoat offers licence-free self-drive canal cruisers, including a 3-night round-trip to Chagny (26 km of canal).
quote: 3-night round trips to Chagny (26km) or Montchanin (38km)

claim: Locaboat operates a hire base in Saint-Léger-sur-Dheune on the Canal du Centre offering no-licence pénichettes after a 1-hour training session.
quote: Location bateau Canal du Centre & Saône

claim: Air Escargot launches from 25 Chemin du 6 Septembre 1944, Remigny (about 8 km from Chagny), with ~1.5-hour flights over Nuits-Saint-Georges, Beaune and Chalon-sur-Saône vineyards.
quote: flights last about an hour and a half

claim: Air Escargot prices are tiered: €240/person for 1–4 passengers, €220 for 5–8, €200 for 9+, with half price for under-12s, including post-flight aperitif and minibus transfer back.
quote: 240 euros per person (1-4 persons), 220 euros per person (5-8 persons), and 200 euros per person (9+ persons)

claim: France Montgolfières flies from Marigny-lès-Reullée near Beaune from 1 April to 31 October, at sunrise or two hours before sunset, with discovery flights priced €199–249 per person.

The Chemin des Grands Crus is an 87 km GR de Pays from Dijon via Beaune to Santenay through the UNESCO Climats, signposted yellow-and-red, divisible into 3–5 day-stage sections served by trains and Transco buses.
quote: 1,247 parcels of vines, also known as "climats", carefully delimited over the centuries

claim: Beaune Tourism markets the Chemin des Grands Crus as the headline vineyard walk through Pommard, Meursault, Chassagne-Montrachet and Santenay, all within 30 km of Chagny.
The GR de Pays des Grands Crus is the recognised long-distance footpath linking Dijon to Santenay through the Côte de Nuits and Côte de Beaune, usable in shorter loops from Meursault or Santenay.
quote: The Great Wines Trail - Grands Crus (Dijon to Santenay, Burgundy)

claim: Valvital's Spa Thermal de Santenay reopens for the 2026 season from 11 February to 27 December, with thermal cures running 16 March to 21 November and an Aqua-détente space (hot pool, hammam, sauna, caldarium).
quote: The Spa Thermal is open from February 11 to December 27, 2026

claim: Casino JOA de Santenay (5 km from Chagny) operates 150 slot machines, English roulette, blackjack and Ultimate Poker tables, open 9 am–2 am weekdays and to 4 am Fri/Sat, with its Comptoir JOA bistro restaurant.
